decisions: Treat .zip/.cbz entries in a supported outer archive as lazy chapter descriptors; derive chapter names from their entry names.
Do not enumerate nested page contents during library scan; resolve only the chapter the user opens.
Keep only the active chapter ZIP in memory, cap it at 64 MiB, and release it on chapter change or reader exit.
Nested ZIP/CBZ support is one level deep; nested 7z/RAR and encrypted inner ZIP are out of scope.
The referenced sample has 438 child ZIPs with a largest uncompressed chapter archive of 42,430,482 bytes; a 64 MiB ceiling bounds the one active in-memory nested ZIP while covering the sample.
implementation_changes: Extend ChapterRef and LibraryIndexStore to persist a nested archive entry path while keeping page lists empty until open.
Add an in-memory nested ZIP reader exposing page paths and on-demand page reads.
Resolve nested pages when ReaderScreen enters that chapter; release resources when the chapter changes or reader exits.
Bump the chapter parser version so existing libraries reindex and discover nested chapter ZIPs.
verification: Nested ZIP fixture with multiple chapters and image pages verifies lazy outer scan, natural page order, and byte reads.
Test 64 MiB boundary, invalid nested ZIP, and persisted nested ChapterRef.
verification_results: ArchiveReaderTest covers lazy chapter discovery, natural inner-page order, page reads, invalid nested ZIP, and the size limit.
LibraryIndexCodecTest covers nested archive path persistence and legacy index compatibility.
melavonmen validate_index.py and validate_schema.py both ok=true, 0 errors.
sync_status: implemented, unit tests and APK build passed, docs validated, and APK installed
sample_evidence: a nested comic archive contains 438 inner ZIPs; summed nested uncompressed size is 2,285,206,218 bytes; largest child ZIP is 42,430,482 bytes, below the 64 MiB limit.
unverified: memory and latency on the 2.18 GB user archive on physical Android
